QuestInfo.name: Frontier Mindset!
QuestInfo.1: When you reach #e#bLv. 100#k#n, go see #bCassandra#k, who's promised to give you #b#t1032085##k.
QuestInfo.2: You reached Lv. 100 and received a new world gift from #bCassandra#k.\r\n#i1032085:# #t1032085#

0.0: Wow! It seems like just yesterday you were struggling to catch Red Snails. I can't believe you're already over Level 70! Very impressive. Now that you've reached Level 70, I have a proposal for you. Want to hear about it?

yes.0: There is an item that is exclusive to the curious and brave pioneers of new worlds. Have you ever heard of the #b#t1032085##k?\nOnly dignified Maplers who have reached#bLevel 100#k in a new place can possess them. Since you've already reached Level 70, why don't you try to obtain the #b#t1032085##k? Come see me when you reach Level 100.\r\n#i1032085# #t1032085#
yes.1: Oh, I nearly forgot! There's a deadline. You must reach Level 100 by #rQRQRQR on TKTKTK#k in order to receive the #t1032085#. Don't forget!

1.0: Wow, I can't believe you really reached #bLevel 100#k! You are amazing! Heheheh, I guess I underestimated you. Not only do you have a strong will, but you also show diligence and a competitive spirit... You deserve a reward. Here, this is the Frontier Earring. Enjoy!

yes.0: You are an outstanding pioneer of the new world. Amazing!

default.0: Come see me if you reach #bLevel 100#k by #rQRQRQR on TKTKTK#k. Then, the #b#t1032085##k will be yours!\r\n#i1032085:# #t1032085#
